flagged.evidence: Verification 1.1 says it “establishes the regression target and population meaning” of the objective, and 2.1 derives the posterior-fiber conclusion under an exact pushforward hypothesis. SCHEMA.md, Algorithms, requires algorithmic properties such as correctness to be proved in separate ordinary result items. These properties are instead argued inside the algorithm carrier.

The cited thm-norm-inequality-for-the-vector-valued-integral applies to the integral defined by def-vector-valued-derivative-and-integral, which defines it componentwise by Darboux (Riemann) integrals. The ODE Statement gives a_K,L_K in Lebesgue L^1, but step 2.1 uses their Lebesgue integrals to bound the Riemann integral of the continuous vector field without stating the bridge that continuous functions have equal Riemann and Lebesgue integrals. The same bridge is used in steps 3.1 and 4.1. It is a small, readily supplied proof gap.
